title: vitis thunbergii
intro: Vitis thunbergii, commonly known as Japanese grapevine or Amur grapevine, is a species of grapevine native to East Asia, particularly in China, Japan, and Korea. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throat, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Vitis thunbergii include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Vitis thunbergii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
